zh: 我出门前穿上外套。
old_en: I put on my coat before leaving the house.
new_en: I put on my coat before leaving.

zh: 我出门前戴上帽子防晒。
old_en: I put on a hat before going out to block the sun.
new_en: I wear a hat before going out to protect from the sun.

zh: 我睡觉前脱掉袜子。
old_en: I took off my socks before sleeping.
new_en: I take off my socks before sleeping.

zh: 太阳很大，她戴上了帽子。
old_en: With the big sun, she put on a hat.
new_en: It's very sunny, so she puts on a hat.

zh: 妹妹穿上毛衣觉得有点热。
old_en: Sister put on the sweater and felt a bit warm.
new_en: My sister feels a bit warm after putting on the sweater.

zh: 进门后我脱下鞋子。
old_en: After entering, I took off my shoes.
new_en: I take off my shoes after entering.

zh: 他进门时脱掉了鞋。
old_en: When he came in, he took off his shoes.
new_en: He takes off his shoes when he comes in.

zh: 我在店里试穿了那件大衣。
old_en: He put on a clean shirt before the interview.
new_en: I try on that coat in the store.

zh: 你出门的时候别忘了穿上外套。
old_en: Don't forget to put on your coat when you go out.
new_en: Don't forget to put on your coat when you go out.

zh: 下雨天我穿上雨鞋。
old_en: On rainy days, I put on rain boots.
new_en: On rainy days, I put on rain boots.

zh: 妈妈叫我穿上雨鞋再出门。
old_en: Put on your rain boots before going out.
new_en: Mom told me to put on rain boots before going out.

zh: 进屋后我脱下外套。
old_en: After entering the house, I took off my coat.
new_en: After entering the house, I took off my coat.

zh: 你出门的时候别忘了戴上帽子。
old_en: Don't forget to put on your hat when you go out.
new_en: Don't forget to put on your hat when you go out.

zh: 开会前我换上了西装。
old_en: I put on a suit before the meeting.
new_en: I changed into a suit before the meeting.

zh: 他开会前换上了一件衬衫。
old_en: He put on a shirt before the meeting.
new_en: He changed into a shirt before the meeting.

zh: 我跑步前穿上运动鞋。
old_en: I put on my running shoes before I start jogging.
new_en: I put on my running shoes before I start jogging.

zh: 运动前记得换上运动鞋。
old_en: Before exercise, remember to put on your sports shoes.
new_en: Remember to change into your sports shoes before exercising.

zh: 天气冷了，我加了一件毛衣。
old_en: It got cold, so I put on another sweater.
new_en: It got cold, so I put on a sweater.

zh: 面试前他换上了干净的衬衫。
old_en: Before the interview, he took off his old shirt and put on a clean one.
new_en: Before the interview, he changed into a clean shirt.

zh: 他试穿新买的裤子觉得不错。
old_en: He tried on the new pants and found them comfortable.
new_en: He tried on his new pants and liked them.
